name: Microsoft Copilot
tagline: Microsoft's AI chat assistant, also built into Word, Excel, Outlook and Teams; work and school accounts use it under Microsoft's business data protection terms

evidence.quote: Microsoft Privacy, Microsoft Corporation, One Microsoft Way, Redmond, Washington 98052, USA
the standard data protection clauses (processor-to-processor module) between Microsoft Ireland Operations Limited and Microsoft Corporation

vendor_entity.note: Organisational use is covered by the Microsoft Products and Services DPA. In the DPA, Microsoft Ireland Operations Limited is the EEA processor that transfers data to Microsoft Corporation under the SCCs; the privacy statement names it as EEA/UK/Swiss controller for consumer data. The contracting entity named in the enterprise agreement itself was not read.

evidence.quote: Microsoft Privacy, Microsoft Corporation, One Microsoft Way, Redmond, Washington 98052, USA

parent_company.note: Microsoft Corporation is itself the top company of the Microsoft group; the privacy statement and About page name no other owner. Microsoft Ireland Operations Limited (EEA) is a Microsoft subsidiary, not a parent.

parent_country.note: No separate parent company (see Parent company); the vendor itself is US-based.

evidence.quote: Microsoft Ireland Operations Limited is Microsoft’s data protection representative for the European Economic Area and Switzerland.

eu_representative.note: Named in the DPA with a Dublin postal address.

evidence.quote: Microsoft Ireland Operations Limited, Attn: Data Protection Officer, One Microsoft Place, South County Business Park, Leopardstown, Dublin 18, Ireland.

dpo_contact.note: DPO is reached by postal address and the privacy support web form; no DPO is named personally.

evidence.quote: For EU Data Boundary Services, Microsoft will store and process Customer Data, Personal Data, and store Professional Services Data at rest within the European Union
For EU customers, Microsoft Copilot is an EU Data Boundary service. Customers outside the EU may have their queries processed in the US, EU, or other regions.

hosting_regions.footnote: For EU/EFTA tenants. Tenants elsewhere are stored in their own geography and may be processed in the US, EU or other regions. Web search queries (Bing) and Anthropic Claude models are outside the EU Data Boundary.
hosting_regions.note: LLM calls can go to other regions at high load: "can call into other regions where capacity is available during high utilization periods".

evidence.quote: Microsoft Copilot calls to the LLM are routed to the closest data centers in the region

local_first.note: Cloud service; no local-only mode found.

evidence.quote: For EU customers, Microsoft Copilot is an EU Data Boundary service.

eu_residency.footnote: Applies to tenants signed up in the EU/EFTA. Excluded: web search queries to Bing, and Anthropic Claude models (off by default in the EU/EFTA and UK; an admin can switch them on).
eu_residency.note: Claude page: "Customers within the EU Data Boundary and customers in the UK have Claude models disabled by" default.

evidence.quote: The EU Data Boundary uses or may use Microsoft datacenters announced or currently operating in Austria, Belgium, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany
Certain AI models used in Microsoft Online Services are hosted on Azure and provided to customers directly by Microsoft (such as Azure OpenAI

cloud_providers.note: Azure is Microsoft's own cloud. Models operated by OpenAI or Anthropic as subprocessors run on those companies' infrastructure, which is not named on the pages read.

evidence.quote: are subject to the terms of the 2021 Standard Contractual Clauses implemented by Microsoft
Microsoft is certified to the EU-U.S. and Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Frameworks, the UK Extension to the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework

transfer_mechanism.note: DPF status is Microsoft's own statement in the DPA. The dataprivacyframework.gov list page did not render its entries, so the listing was not checked there.

evidence.quote: The Microsoft Online Services Subprocessor List identifies subprocessors authorized to subprocess customer or personal data in Microsoft Online Services.
Microsoft General - Online Services Subprocessors List (2026-11-04)

subprocessors_public.note: Published as a document on the Service Trust Portal.

subprocessors_count.note: source blocked: https://servicetrust.microsoft.com/ViewPage/DocumentPreview?documentId=37bec9fa-5bbd-450f-8178-1418411358ba (the list opens only in a script-driven document viewer that returned no text). Named AI subprocessors for Copilot: OpenAI and Anthropic.

evidence.quote: provide Customer with a mechanism to obtain notice of that update of any new Subprocessor at least 6 months in advance
To receive notifications of updates to this Subprocessor list, please follow the instructions that describe My library functionality.

subprocessor_notice.note: For subprocessors that support AI functions the DPA gives 30 days' notice, with the ability to disable that subprocessor until at least 6 months after notice.

evidence.quote: The current and archived editions of the DPA are available for download.
is covered by the terms of the Microsoft Products and Services Data Protection Addendum (DPA) and Microsoft Product Terms , with Microsoft acting as a data processor.

dpa.note: November 2026 English DPA read in full (saved copy of the .docx download).

evidence.quote: with Microsoft acting as a data processor.
This means that Microsoft acts as an independent data controller responsible for complying with all applicable laws and controller obligations.

role.note: Processor for prompts, responses and Microsoft 365 data of work/school accounts; independent controller for the web search queries Copilot sends to Bing. "Anthropic models with Data Retention" (admin opt-in) fall under Anthropic's own terms, not the Microsoft DPA.
role.footnote: Personal Microsoft accounts (consumer Copilot): Microsoft is controller under the Microsoft Privacy Statement.

evidence.quote: Last Updated: November 2026

privacy_policy_date.note: Only month and year are shown; the change-history page returned 404. The DPA is dated November 1, 2026.

evidence.quote: Admins can also use Microsoft Purview to set retention policies for the data related to chat interactions with Copilot.
Retain your conversation history for 18 months.

retention_stated.footnote: Work/school accounts: kept until the user deletes it or the institution's retention policy removes it (no fixed vendor period). Personal accounts: conversation history kept 18 months.
retention_stated.note: Users can delete their Copilot activity history in the My Account portal.

evidence.quote: After the 90-day retention period ends, Microsoft will disable Customer’s account and delete the Customer Data and Personal Data stored in Online Services within an additional 90 days

deletion_on_exit.note: Data is kept 90 days after the subscription ends so the customer can extract it, then deleted within a further 90 days.

evidence.quote: Export Copilot activity records for detailed analysis or compliance reporting.
you can view, access, export and delete Copilot activity history from your privacy dashboard

data_export.note: Admins can find stored prompts/responses with Content search and export audit records; personal-account users can export history from the privacy dashboard. No user-facing export of Copilot chats in open formats documented for work/school accounts.

breach_notice.value: Without undue delay and in any event within 72 hours

evidence.quote: notification by Microsoft (as described in the “Security Incident Notification” section above) will be made without undue delay and, in any event, within 72 hours.

governing_law.note: Looked at the DPA, Product Terms and the Microsoft Customer Agreement page; the governing-law clause of the enterprise/education agreement was not on the pages read. The consumer Microsoft Services Agreement sets US-resident law and King County, Washington courts; that is not the institutional contract.

evidence.quote: Microsoft Copilot is a sophisticated processing and orchestration engine that provides AI-powered productivity capabilities
In addition to OpenAI models that Microsoft operates (Azure OpenAI), Microsoft now provides OpenAI operated models through OpenAI as a subprocessor.
Microsoft offers third-party AI models in Microsoft Copilot, such as Anthropic and OpenAI models.
We may deploy other AI models for Microsoft Copilot to use that are hosted and operated by Microsoft.

ai_providers.note: OpenAI-operated models are on by default for eligible commercial customers since July 24, 2026; Claude models are on by default outside the EU/EFTA and UK and off by default inside them. Admins can switch either subprocessor off.

evidence.quote: Prompts, responses, and data accessed through Microsoft Graph aren't used to train foundation LLMs, including those used by Microsoft Copilot.

trains_on_content.footnote: Personal Microsoft accounts: conversations are used to train Microsoft's generative AI models unless the user opts out ("Training on conversation activity" setting).
trains_on_content.note: Work/school feedback may be used to improve Copilot but not to train the foundation LLMs. Consumer page: "You can opt out of using your conversation activity for model training at any time."

evidence.quote: OpenAI offers Zero Data Retention for the Responses API used by Microsoft, subject to the limitations and feature-specific data handling practices
While abuse monitoring, which includes human review of content, is available in Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot services have opted out of it.

ai_zero_retention.footnote: Not for "Anthropic models with Data Retention" (admin opt-in): Anthropic stores most inputs and outputs for up to 30 days under its own terms.
ai_zero_retention.note: Stated for OpenAI-operated models (Responses API) and Azure OpenAI abuse monitoring. No retention statement found for the default Anthropic subprocessor models.

evidence.quote: If you turn off connected experiences that analyze your content on devices in your organization, Microsoft Copilot features won't be available to your users
Remove or prevent installation of the Copilot app

ai_admin_off.note: Admins also choose which users get Copilot licences and can switch off the OpenAI and Anthropic subprocessors, web search and agents.

evidence.quote: Microsoft is committed to building products and solutions that comply with the EU AI Act and helping our customers use AI compliantly.

ai_act_statement.note: Trust Center EU AI Act page (company-wide, not Copilot-specific).

evidence.quote: Microsoft Copilot provides broad compliance offerings and certifications, including GDPR , ISO 27001 , HIPAA , and the ISO 42001 standard for AI management systems
Microsoft AI services in scope for ISO 42001 certification
those measures shall comply with the requirements set forth in ISO 27001, ISO 27002, and ISO 27018.
Microsoft 365 Central Services - SOC 2 Type 2 Report (9-30-2025)

certifications.note: ISO 42001 scope list names Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Chat. ISO 27001 is claimed for Copilot on the privacy page; ISO 27018 is a DPA commitment; SOC 2 Type 2 is a Microsoft 365 report (Copilot's inclusion in its scope was not checked in the report itself).

evidence.quote: Learn how Microsoft cloud services protect your data, and how you can manage cloud data security and compliance for your organization.
We help protect your data with encryption at rest and in transit
Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions

encryption.note: Microsoft Purview Customer Key (customer-managed keys) lists Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions among the data its multi-workload encryption policy covers; it is a separately licensed feature.

evidence.quote: Office 365 regularly conducts red-team exercises in which an internal penetration testing team simulates attacker behavior against the live environment.

pentest.note: Internal red-team testing claimed for Office 365; no shareable independent pentest summary for Copilot found.

evidence.quote: The Microsoft Copilot bounty program invites eligible security researchers to discover vulnerabilities in the new, innovative, Microsoft Copilot .

vuln_disclosure.note: Copilot-specific bounty run by the Microsoft Security Response Center, alongside its coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy.

incidents.value: No Copilot breach or regulator fine found. Microsoft disclosed and fixed a Microsoft 365 Copilot information-disclosure vulnerability (CVE-2025-32711, June 2025).

evidence.quote: This vulnerability has already been fully mitigated by Microsoft.

incidents.note: Primary source: Microsoft Security Update Guide. A search also found decisions of the Austrian data protection authority (Oct 2025, Jan 2026) on Microsoft 365 Education (access rights, tracking cookies), not Copilot specifically; the decision PDF could not be fetched (timeout), so they are not recorded as verified. Lawsuits not searched.

evidence.quote: Service Health Status
It does not apply to the use of Microsoft 365 Copilot when signed in with a work or school account (Entra ID).

sso.note: Sign-in is with a Microsoft Entra ID work or school account (or a personal Microsoft account). Institutions can federate Entra ID with their own SAML identity provider, e.g. via a Shibboleth proxy.

evidence.quote: Multilateral federation Solution 2: Microsoft Entra ID with Shibboleth as a Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) proxy

federation.note: Copilot is not a federation service provider itself; Microsoft documents bridge designs for universities. Federation member lists not searched directly.

scim.note: Copilot users are Entra ID accounts in the institution's tenant; the Entra SCIM page cached covers provisioning from Entra to other apps, not into Copilot. No Copilot-specific SCIM statement found.

evidence.quote: Multifactor authentication is a process in which users are prompted during the sign-in process for an additional form of identification

mfa.note: Via Microsoft Entra ID multifactor authentication, which covers the work/school accounts used to sign in to Copilot.

evidence.quote: As an administrator, you can manage many Microsoft Copilot settings from Copilot > Settings in the Microsoft 365 admin center
Microsoft Purview Audit automatically logs Copilot interactions.
The full capabilities of Word, PowerPoint, and Excel, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, are now available within the LMS experience
Deploy Microsoft 365 LTI in any LTI® 1.3 Advantage Platform

lms_integration.note: Through the Microsoft 365 LTI app (LTI 1.3), with deployment guides for Canvas, Blackboard, Brightspace and Moodle. Copilot comes in via Word, PowerPoint and Excel inside the LMS, not as a separate Copilot LTI tool.

vpat.note: Microsoft publishes ACRs (VPAT format) on its Accessibility Conformance Reports page, but no Copilot-specific report was found there or by web search.

wcag_level.note: Microsoft says it builds against WCAG, EN 301 549 and Section 508 company-wide; no Copilot-specific WCAG level claim found.

evidence.quote: Microsoft publishes Accessibility Conformance Reports (ACRs) describing how our products and services support the criteria of the European accessibility standard, EN 301 549

accessibility_statement.note: Company-wide accessibility pages; no Copilot-specific statement found.

hecvat.note: No HECVAT found on the Service Trust Portal pages read or by web search; the Learn HECVAT page returned 404.

execution of Customer’s agreement includes execution of the HIPAA Business Associate Agreement (“BAA”).

evidence.quote: Copilot Chat is available at no cost for users with a Microsoft 365 A1, A3, or A5 license when signed in with their school or work account.

free_plan.footnote: Copilot Chat is free for institutions with Microsoft 365 education licences; the full Microsoft 365 Copilot (inside the institution's files, mail and Teams) is a paid add-on. Personal accounts also have a free Copilot.

price_individual.value: USD 18 per user per month (Microsoft 365 Copilot academic offering)

evidence.quote: Available now as an academic offering for $18 (USD) per user per month.

price_individual.footnote: Academic price for educators, staff and students 13+. Enterprise add-on: USD 30/user/month (annual); Copilot Business add-on: USD 21 (offer 18). Personal: Microsoft 365 Personal with Copilot from USD 9.99/month.
price_individual.note: The add-on needs an eligible Microsoft 365 base licence. Prices are US list prices.

evidence.quote: Copilot Chat is available at no cost for users with a Microsoft 365 A1, A3, or A5 license when signed in with their school or work account.

institutional_licence.note: Bought by the institution through its Microsoft 365 education tenant: Copilot Chat comes with A1/A3/A5 licences, and Microsoft 365 Copilot is a per-user add-on the institution assigns. No flat campus-wide price for the add-on was found.

evidence.quote: Available now as an academic offering for $18 (USD) per user per month.
